question: What outcomes would the business sponsor use to judge success, and how would each be measured?

needs.need: The business needs to measure and report on the percentage of orders fulfilled within the target timeframe (e.g., <60 minutes) to validate operational efficiency and service speed commitments.
needs.why: Meeting strict delivery windows is the core value proposition of the Q-Commerce model and directly drives customer retention and repeat usage.

needs.need: The business needs to track the rate of inventory discrepancies and overselling incidents to ensure accurate availability data and minimize order failures.
needs.why: Accurate inventory synchronization is critical for maintaining customer trust and preventing revenue loss from failed deliveries in a high-velocity environment.

needs.need: The business needs to monitor the efficiency of revenue streams, specifically the ratio of transaction commissions and delivery fees against operational costs, to ensure profitability.
needs.why: Sustaining the gig-economy logistics model requires rigorous cost control and optimization of multiple monetization channels to achieve a positive unit economics.
